123struct FRenderThreadIdleScope
124{
125 UE::Stats::FThreadIdleStats::FScopeIdle RHIThreadIdleScope;
126
127 const ERenderThreadIdleTypes::Type Type;
128 const bool bCondition;
129 const uint32 Start;
130
131 FRenderThreadIdleScope(ERenderThreadIdleTypes::Type Type, bool bInCondition = true)
132 : RHIThreadIdleScope(!(bInCondition && IsInRHIThread()))
133 , Type(Type)
134 , bCondition(bInCondition && IsInRenderingThread())
135 , Start(bCondition ? FPlatformTime::Cycles() : 0)
136 {}
137
138 ~FRenderThreadIdleScope()
139 {
140 if (bCondition)
141 {
142 GRenderThreadIdle[Type] += FPlatformTime::Cycles() - Start;
143 }
144 }
145};

286struct FLockTracker
287{
288 struct FLockParams
289 {
290 void* RHIBuffer;
291 void* Buffer;
292 uint32 BufferSize;
293 uint32 Offset;
294 EResourceLockMode LockMode;
295
296 inline FLockParams(void* InRHIBuffer, void* InBuffer, uint32 InOffset, uint32 InBufferSize, EResourceLockMode InLockMode)
297 : RHIBuffer(InRHIBuffer)
298 , Buffer(InBuffer)
299 , BufferSize(InBufferSize)
300 , Offset(InOffset)
301 , LockMode(InLockMode)
302 {
303 }
304 };
305
306 FCriticalSection CriticalSection;
307 TArray<FLockParams, TInlineAllocator<16> > OutstandingLocks;
308
309 FLockTracker()
310 {
311 }
312
313 inline void Lock(void* RHIBuffer, void* Buffer, uint32 Offset, uint32 SizeRHI, EResourceLockMode LockMode)
314 {
315 FScopeLock Lock(&CriticalSection);
316#if DO_CHECK
317 for (auto& Parms : OutstandingLocks)
318 {
319 check(Parms.RHIBuffer != RHIBuffer);
320 }
321#endif
322 OutstandingLocks.Add(FLockParams(RHIBuffer, Buffer, Offset, SizeRHI, LockMode));
323 }
324 inline FLockParams Unlock(void* RHIBuffer)
325 {
326 FScopeLock Lock(&CriticalSection);
327 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < OutstandingLocks.Num(); Index++)
328 {
329 if (OutstandingLocks[Index].RHIBuffer == RHIBuffer)
330 {
331 FLockParams Result = OutstandingLocks[Index];
332 OutstandingLocks.RemoveAtSwap(Index, EAllowShrinking::No);
333 return Result;
334 }
335 }
336 check(!"Mismatched RHI buffer locks.");
337 return FLockParams(nullptr, nullptr, 0, 0, RLM_WriteOnly);
338 }
339};

353template <typename RHICmdListType, typename LAMBDA>
354struct TRHILambdaCommand final : public FRHICommandBase
355{

357#if CPUPROFILERTRACE_ENABLED

359#endif
360
361 TRHILambdaCommand(LAMBDA&& InLambda, const TCHAR* InName)
362 : Lambda(Forward<LAMBDA>(InLambda))
363#if CPUPROFILERTRACE_ENABLED
364 , Name(InName)

369 {
370 TRACE_CPUPROFILER_EVENT_SCOPE_TEXT_ON_CHANNEL(Name, RHICommandsChannel);

419// Issues a single fence at the end of the scope if an RHI fence is requested by commands within the scope. Can

422{
423 friend class FRHICommandListBase;

425 FRHICommandListScopedFence* Previous;
426 bool bFenceRequested = false;
427

430 ~FRHICommandListScopedFence();
431};

455protected:

458 RHI_API FRHICommandListBase(FRHIGPUMask InGPUMask, bool bInImmediate);
459
460public:
461 // Move only.

467 inline bool IsImmediate() const;
468 inline FRHICommandListImmediate& GetAsImmediate();
469 const int32 GetUsedMemory() const;
470
471 bool AllowParallelTranslate() const
472 {
473 // Command lists cannot be translated in parallel for various reasons...
474
475 // Parallel translate might be explicitly disabled (e.g. platform RHI doesn't support parallel translate)
476 if (!bAllowParallelTranslate)
477 {
478 return false;
479 }
480
481 // All commands recorded by the immediate command list must not be parallel translated.
482 // This is mostly for legacy reasons, since various parts of the renderer / RHI expect immediate commands to be single-threaded.
483 if (PersistentState.bImmediate)
484 {
485 return false;
486 }
487
488 // Command lists that use RHIThreadFence(true) are going to mutate resource state, so must be single-threaded.
489 if (bUsesLockFence)
490 {
491 return false;
492 }
493
494 // Some shader bundle implementations do not currently support parallel translate
495 if (bUsesShaderBundles && !GRHISupportsShaderBundleParallel)
496 {
497 return false;
498 }
499
500 return true;
501 }
502
503 //
504 // Adds a graph event as a dispatch dependency. The command list will not be dispatched to the
505 // RHI / parallel translate threads until all its dispatch prerequisites have been completed.
506 //
507 // Not safe to call after FinishRecording().
508 //
509 RHI_API void AddDispatchPrerequisite(const FGraphEventRef& Prereq);
510
511 //
512 // Marks the RHI command list as completed, allowing it to be dispatched to the RHI / parallel translate threads.
513 //
514 // Must be called as the last command in a parallel rendering task. It is not safe to continue using the command
515 // list after FinishRecording() has been called.
516 //
517 // Never call on the immediate command list.
518 //
519 RHI_API void FinishRecording();

566 inline void* AllocCommand(int32 AllocSize, int32 Alignment)
567 {
568 checkSlow(!IsExecuting());
569 checkfSlow(!Bypass(), TEXT("Invalid attempt to record commands in bypass mode."));
570 FRHICommandBase* Result = (FRHICommandBase*) MemManager.Alloc(AllocSize, Alignment);
571 ++NumCommands;
572 *CommandLink = Result;
573 CommandLink = &Result->Next;
574 return Result;
575 }

583 enum class EThreadFence
584 {
585 Enabled,
586 Disabled
587 };
588
589 template <typename LAMBDA>
590 inline void EnqueueLambda(EThreadFence ThreadFence, const TCHAR* LambdaName, LAMBDA&& Lambda)
591 {
592 if (IsBottomOfPipe())
593 {
594 Lambda(*this);
595 }
596 else
597 {
598 ALLOC_COMMAND(TRHILambdaCommand<FRHICommandListBase, LAMBDA>)(Forward<LAMBDA>(Lambda), LambdaName);
599
600 if (ThreadFence == EThreadFence::Enabled)
601 {
602 RHIThreadFence(true);
603 }
604 }
605 }
606
607 template <typename LAMBDA>
608 inline void EnqueueLambda(const TCHAR* LambdaName, LAMBDA&& Lambda)
609 {
610 FRHICommandListBase::EnqueueLambda(EThreadFence::Disabled, LambdaName, Forward<LAMBDA>(Lambda));
611 }
612
613 template <typename LAMBDA>
614 inline void EnqueueLambda(LAMBDA&& Lambda)
615 {
616 FRHICommandListBase::EnqueueLambda(TEXT("TRHILambdaCommand"), Forward<LAMBDA>(Lambda));
617 }
618
619 template <typename LAMBDA>
620 void EnqueueLambdaMultiPipe(ERHIPipeline Pipelines, EThreadFence ThreadFence, const TCHAR* LambdaName, LAMBDA&& Lambda)
621 {
622 checkf(IsTopOfPipe() || Bypass(), TEXT("Cannot enqueue a multi-pipe lambda from the bottom of pipe."));
623
624 ERHIPipeline OldPipeline = ActivePipelines;
625 ActivatePipelines(Pipelines);
626
627 if (IsBottomOfPipe())
628 {
629 FRHIContextArray LocalContexts { InPlace, nullptr };
630 for (ERHIPipeline Pipeline : MakeFlagsRange(Pipelines))
631 {
632 LocalContexts[Pipeline] = Contexts[Pipeline];
633 check(LocalContexts[Pipeline]);
634 }
635
636 // Static cast to enforce const type in lambda args
637 Lambda(static_cast<FRHIContextArray const&>(LocalContexts));
638 }
639 else
640 {
641 ALLOC_COMMAND(TRHILambdaCommandMultiPipe<FRHICommandListBase, LAMBDA>)(Forward<LAMBDA>(Lambda), LambdaName, Pipelines);
642 }
643
644 ActivatePipelines(OldPipeline);
645
646 if (ThreadFence == EThreadFence::Enabled)
647 {
648 RHIThreadFence(true);
649 }
650 }

773 // LockBufferMGPU / UnlockBufferMGPU may ONLY be called for buffers with the EBufferUsageFlags::MultiGPUAllocate flag set!
774 // And buffers with that flag set may not call the regular (single GPU) LockBuffer / UnlockBuffer. The single GPU version
775 // of LockBuffer uses driver mirroring to propagate the updated buffer to other GPUs, while the MGPU / MultiGPUAllocate
776 // version requires the caller to manually lock and initialize the buffer separately on each GPU. This can be done by
777 // iterating over FRHIGPUMask::All() and calling LockBufferMGPU / UnlockBufferMGPU for each version.
778 //
779 // EBufferUsageFlags::MultiGPUAllocate is only needed for cases where CPU initialized data needs to be different per GPU,
780 // which is a rare edge case. Currently, this is only used for the ray tracing acceleration structure address buffer,
781 // which contains virtual address references to other GPU resources, which may be in a different location on each GPU.
782 //
783 inline void* LockBufferMGPU(FRHIBuffer* Buffer, uint32 GPUIndex, uint32 Offset, uint32 SizeRHI, EResourceLockMode LockMode)
784 {
785 checkf(IsTopOfPipe() || Bypass(), TEXT("Buffers may only be locked while recording RHI command lists, not during RHI command list execution."));
786
787 return GDynamicRHI->RHILockBufferMGPU(*this, Buffer, GPUIndex, Offset, SizeRHI, LockMode);
788 }
789
790 inline void UnlockBufferMGPU(FRHIBuffer* Buffer, uint32 GPUIndex)
791 {
792 checkf(IsTopOfPipe() || Bypass(), TEXT("Buffers may only be unlocked while recording RHI command lists, not during RHI command list execution."));
793
794 GDynamicRHI->RHIUnlockBufferMGPU(*this, Buffer, GPUIndex);
795 }

1047 /*
1048 * Writes the GPU addresses of the provided resources into a GPU buffer that can be accessed in shaders.
1049 * Addresses should be queried immediately before use, as certain RHI operations such as lock/update/defragment may move the resources in memory.
1050 */
1051 void WriteResourceGPUAddresses(TConstArrayView<FRHIResource*> Resources, FRHIBuffer* OutputBuffer)
1052 {
1053 if (!Bypass())
1054 {
1055 Resources = AllocArray(Resources);
1056 }
1057
1058 for (uint32 GPUIndex : GetGPUMask())
1059 {
1060 uint64* AddressesPtr = (uint64*)LockBufferMGPU(
1061 OutputBuffer,
1062 GPUIndex,
1063 0,
1064 Resources.Num() * sizeof(uint64), RLM_WriteOnly);
1065
1066 GDynamicRHI->RHIWriteResourceGPUAddresses(*this, GPUIndex, Resources, AddressesPtr);
1067
1068 UnlockBufferMGPU(OutputBuffer, GPUIndex);
1069 }
1070 }

1089 case SF_Geometry: checkSlow(PersistentState.BoundShaderInput.GetGeometryShader() == ShaderRHI); break;
1090 default: checkfSlow(false, TEXT("Unexpected shader type %d"), ShaderRHI->GetFrequency());

1217 FShaderParameterState(FShaderParameterState&& RHS)
1218 {
1219 AllocatorsRoot = RHS.AllocatorsRoot;
1220 ScratchShaderParameters = RHS.ScratchShaderParameters;
1221 RHS.AllocatorsRoot = nullptr;
1222 RHS.ScratchShaderParameters = nullptr;

1224
1225 ~FShaderParameterState()
1226 {
1227 if (ScratchShaderParameters)
1228 {
1229 ScratchShaderParameters->~FRHIBatchedShaderParameters();
1230 ScratchShaderParameters = nullptr;
1231 }
1232
1233 for (FRHIBatchedShaderParametersAllocator* Node = AllocatorsRoot; Node; Node = Node->Next)
1234 {
1235 Node->~FRHIBatchedShaderParametersAllocator();
1236 }
1237 AllocatorsRoot = nullptr;
1238 }
1239 };

1397struct FUnnamedRhiCommand
1398{
1399 static const TCHAR* TStr() { return TEXT("FUnnamedRhiCommand"); }
1400};
1401
1402template<typename TCmd, typename NameType = FUnnamedRhiCommand>
1403struct FRHICommand : public FRHICommandBase
1404{
1405#if RHICOMMAND_CALLSTACK
1406 uint64 StackFrames[16];
1407
1408 FRHICommand()
1409 {
1410 FPlatformStackWalk::CaptureStackBackTrace(StackFrames, 16);
1411 }
1412#endif
1413
1414 void ExecuteAndDestruct(FRHICommandListBase& CmdList) override final
1415 {
1416 LLM_SCOPE_BYNAME(TEXT("RHIMisc/CommandList/ExecuteAndDestruct"));
1417 TRACE_CPUPROFILER_EVENT_SCOPE_ON_CHANNEL_STR(NameType::TStr(), RHICommandsChannel);
1418
1419 TCmd* ThisCmd = static_cast<TCmd*>(this);
1420 ThisCmd->Execute(CmdList);
1421 ThisCmd->~TCmd();
1422 }
1423};

2519 template <typename LAMBDA>
2520 inline void EnqueueLambda(EThreadFence ThreadFence, const TCHAR* LambdaName, LAMBDA&& Lambda)
2521 {
2522 if (IsBottomOfPipe())
2523 {
2524 Lambda(*this);
2525 }
2526 else
2527 {
2528 ALLOC_COMMAND(TRHILambdaCommand<FRHIComputeCommandList, LAMBDA>)(Forward<LAMBDA>(Lambda), LambdaName);
2529
2530 if (ThreadFence == EThreadFence::Enabled)
2531 {
2532 RHIThreadFence(true);
2533 }
2534 }
2535 }
2536
2537 // Same as EnqueueLambda, but skips the Insights marker surrounding the lambda. Used by the RHI breadcrumb system.
2538 template <typename LAMBDA>
2539 inline void EnqueueLambda_NoMarker(LAMBDA&& Lambda)
2540 {
2541 if (IsBottomOfPipe())
2542 {
2543 Lambda(*this);
2544 }
2545 else
2546 {
2547 ALLOC_COMMAND(TRHILambdaCommand_NoMarker<FRHIComputeCommandList, LAMBDA>)(Forward<LAMBDA>(Lambda));
2548 }
2549 }

2819 inline void SetTrackedAccess(TArrayView<const FRHITransitionInfo> Infos, ERHIPipeline PipelinesAfter)
2820 {
2821 FRHITrackedAccessInfo* TrackedAccessInfos = reinterpret_cast<FRHITrackedAccessInfo*>(Alloc(sizeof(FRHITrackedAccessInfo) * Infos.Num(), alignof(FRHITrackedAccessInfo)));
2822 int32 NumTrackedAccessInfos = 0;
2823
2824 for (const FRHITransitionInfo& Info : Infos)
2825 {
2826 ensureMsgf(Info.IsWholeResource(), TEXT("The Transition method only supports whole resource transitions."));
2827
2828 if (FRHIViewableResource* Resource = GetViewableResource(Info))
2829 {
2830 new (&TrackedAccessInfos[NumTrackedAccessInfos++]) FRHITrackedAccessInfo(Resource, Info.AccessAfter, PipelinesAfter);
2831 }
2832 }
2833
2834 if (NumTrackedAccessInfos > 0)
2835 {
2836 SetTrackedAccess(TArrayView<FRHITrackedAccessInfo>(TrackedAccessInfos, NumTrackedAccessInfos));
2837 }

3023 inline void BeginBreadcrumbCPU(FRHIBreadcrumbNode* Breadcrumb, bool bLink)
3024 {
3025 check(Breadcrumb && Breadcrumb != FRHIBreadcrumbNode::Sentinel);
3026 BreadcrumbAllocatorRefs.AddUnique(Breadcrumb->Allocator);
3027
3028 if (IsTopOfPipe())
3029 {
3030 // Recording thread
3031 Breadcrumb->TraceBeginCPU();
3032 PersistentState.LocalBreadcrumb = Breadcrumb;
3033
3034 if (bLink)
3035 {
3036 CPUBreadcrumbState.Current = Breadcrumb;
3037
3038 if (Breadcrumb->GetParent() == FRHIBreadcrumbNode::Sentinel)
3039 {
3040 CPUBreadcrumbState.UnknownParentList.Append(Breadcrumb);
3041 }
3042 }
3043 }
3044
3045 EnqueueLambda_NoMarker([Breadcrumb, bLink](FRHICommandListBase& ExecutingCmdList)
3046 {
3047 // Translating thread
3048 ExecutingCmdList.PersistentState.LocalBreadcrumb = Breadcrumb;
3049
3050 if (bLink)
3051 {
3052 ExecutingCmdList.CPUBreadcrumbState.Current = Breadcrumb;
3053 Breadcrumb->TraceBeginCPU();
3054 }
3055 });
3056 }
3057
3058 inline void EndBreadcrumbCPU(FRHIBreadcrumbNode* Breadcrumb, bool bLink)
3059 {
3060 check(Breadcrumb && Breadcrumb != FRHIBreadcrumbNode::Sentinel);
3061 BreadcrumbAllocatorRefs.AddUnique(Breadcrumb->Allocator);
3062
3063 if (IsTopOfPipe())
3064 {
3065 // Recording thread
3066 Breadcrumb->TraceEndCPU();
3067 PersistentState.LocalBreadcrumb = Breadcrumb->GetParent();
3068
3069 if (bLink)
3070 {
3071 CPUBreadcrumbState.Current = Breadcrumb->GetParent();
3072 }
3073 }
3074
3075 EnqueueLambda_NoMarker([Breadcrumb, bLink](FRHICommandListBase& ExecutingCmdList)
3076 {
3077 // Translating thread
3078 ExecutingCmdList.PersistentState.LocalBreadcrumb = Breadcrumb->GetParent();
3079 check(ExecutingCmdList.PersistentState.LocalBreadcrumb != FRHIBreadcrumbNode::Sentinel);
3080
3081 if (bLink)
3082 {
3083 ExecutingCmdList.CPUBreadcrumbState.Current = Breadcrumb->GetParent();
3084 check(ExecutingCmdList.CPUBreadcrumbState.Current != FRHIBreadcrumbNode::Sentinel);
3085
3086 Breadcrumb->TraceEndCPU();
3087 }
3088 });
3089 }
3090
3091 inline void BeginBreadcrumbGPU(FRHIBreadcrumbNode* Breadcrumb, ERHIPipeline Pipeline)
3092 {
3093 check(Breadcrumb && Breadcrumb != FRHIBreadcrumbNode::Sentinel);
3094 check(IsSingleRHIPipeline(Pipeline));
3095 check(EnumHasAllFlags(ActivePipelines, Pipeline));
3096#if DO_CHECK
3097 check(!EnumHasAnyFlags(ERHIPipeline(Breadcrumb->BeginPipes.fetch_or(std::underlying_type_t<ERHIPipeline>(Pipeline))), Pipeline));
3098#endif
3099
3100 BreadcrumbAllocatorRefs.AddUnique(Breadcrumb->Allocator);
3101
3102 auto& State = GPUBreadcrumbState[Pipeline];
3103 State.Current = Breadcrumb;
3104 State.Latest = Breadcrumb;
3105
3106 EnqueueLambda(TEXT("BeginBreadcrumbGPU"), [Breadcrumb, Pipeline](FRHICommandListBase& ExecutingCmdList)
3107 {
3108 auto& State = ExecutingCmdList.GPUBreadcrumbState[Pipeline];
3109
3110 State.Range.InsertAfter(Breadcrumb, State.Prev, Pipeline);
3111 State.Prev = Breadcrumb;
3112
3113 State.Current = Breadcrumb;
3114 State.Latest = Breadcrumb;
3115
3116 ExecutingCmdList.Contexts[Pipeline]->RHIBeginBreadcrumbGPU(Breadcrumb);
3117 });
3118 }
3119
3120 inline void EndBreadcrumbGPU(FRHIBreadcrumbNode* Breadcrumb, ERHIPipeline Pipeline)
3121 {
3122 check(Breadcrumb && Breadcrumb != FRHIBreadcrumbNode::Sentinel);
3123 check(IsSingleRHIPipeline(Pipeline));
3124 check(EnumHasAllFlags(ActivePipelines, Pipeline));
3125#if DO_CHECK
3126 check(!EnumHasAnyFlags(ERHIPipeline(Breadcrumb->EndPipes.fetch_or(std::underlying_type_t<ERHIPipeline>(Pipeline))), Pipeline));
3127#endif
3128
3129 BreadcrumbAllocatorRefs.AddUnique(Breadcrumb->Allocator);
3130
3131 auto& State = GPUBreadcrumbState[Pipeline];
3132 State.Current = Breadcrumb->GetParent();
3133 State.Latest = Breadcrumb->GetParent();
3134
3135 EnqueueLambda(TEXT("EndBreadcrumbGPU"), [Breadcrumb, Pipeline](FRHICommandListBase& ExecutingCmdList)
3136 {
3137 auto& State = ExecutingCmdList.GPUBreadcrumbState[Pipeline];
3138
3139 State.Current = Breadcrumb->GetParent();
3140 check(State.Current != FRHIBreadcrumbNode::Sentinel);
3141
3142 State.Latest = Breadcrumb->GetParent();
3143 check(State.Latest != FRHIBreadcrumbNode::Sentinel);
3144
3145 ExecutingCmdList.Contexts[Pipeline]->RHIEndBreadcrumbGPU(Breadcrumb);
3146 });
3147 }
3148#endif // WITH_RHI_BREADCRUMBS

3494
3495 inline void BuildAccelerationStructures(TConstArrayView<FRayTracingGeometryBuildParams> Params, const FRHIBufferRange& ScratchBufferRange)
3496 {
3497 if (Bypass())
3498 {
3499 GetComputeContext().RHIBuildAccelerationStructures(Params, ScratchBufferRange);
3500 }
3501 else
3502 {
3503 // Copy the params themselves as well their segment lists, if there are any.
3504 // AllocArray() can't be used here directly, as we have to modify the params after copy.
3505 size_t DataSize = sizeof(FRayTracingGeometryBuildParams) * Params.Num();
3506 FRayTracingGeometryBuildParams* InlineParams = (FRayTracingGeometryBuildParams*) Alloc(DataSize, alignof(FRayTracingGeometryBuildParams));
3507 FMemory::Memcpy(InlineParams, Params.GetData(), DataSize);
3508 for (int32 i=0; i<Params.Num(); ++i)
3509 {
3510 if (Params[i].Segments.Num())
3511 {
3512 InlineParams[i].Segments = AllocArray(Params[i].Segments);
3513 }
3514 }
3515 ALLOC_COMMAND(FRHICommandBuildAccelerationStructures)(MakeArrayView(InlineParams, Params.Num()), ScratchBufferRange);
3516
3517 RHIThreadFence(true);
3518 }
3519 }
3520
3521 inline void BuildAccelerationStructure(const FRayTracingSceneBuildParams& SceneBuildParams)
3522 {
3523 BuildAccelerationStructures(MakeConstArrayView(&SceneBuildParams, 1));
3524 }
3525
3526 inline void BuildAccelerationStructures(TConstArrayView<FRayTracingSceneBuildParams> Params)
3527 {
3528 if (Bypass())
3529 {
3530 GetComputeContext().RHIBuildAccelerationStructures(Params);
3531 }
3532 else
3533 {
3534 // Copy the params themselves as well their ReferencedGeometries/ReferencedBuffers, if there are any.
3535 // AllocArray() can't be used here directly, as we have to modify the params after copy.
3536 size_t DataSize = sizeof(FRayTracingSceneBuildParams) * Params.Num();
3537 FRayTracingSceneBuildParams* InlineParams = (FRayTracingSceneBuildParams*)Alloc(DataSize, alignof(FRayTracingSceneBuildParams));
3538 FMemory::Memcpy(InlineParams, Params.GetData(), DataSize);
3539 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < Params.Num(); ++Index)
3540 {
3541 if (Params[Index].ReferencedGeometries.Num())
3542 {
3543 InlineParams[Index].ReferencedGeometries = AllocArray(Params[Index].ReferencedGeometries);
3544 }
3545
3546 if (Params[Index].ReferencedBuffers.Num())
3547 {
3548 InlineParams[Index].ReferencedBuffers = AllocArray(Params[Index].ReferencedBuffers);
3549 }
3550 }
3551
3552 ALLOC_COMMAND(FRHICommandBuildSceneAccelerationStructures)(MakeConstArrayView(InlineParams, Params.Num()));
3553
3554 // This RHI command modifies members of the FRHIRayTracingScene inside platform RHI implementations.
3555 // It therefore needs the RHI lock fence to prevent races on those members.
3556 RHIThreadFence(true);
3557 }
3558 }

3626 {
3627 if (IsBottomOfPipe())
3628 {
3629 Lambda(*this);

3637 RHIThreadFence(true);
3638 }
3639 }

3831 void ApplyCachedRenderTargets(
3832 FGraphicsPipelineStateInitializer& GraphicsPSOInit
3833 )
3834 {
3835 GraphicsPSOInit.RenderTargetsEnabled = PersistentState.CachedNumSimultanousRenderTargets;
3836
3837 for (uint32 i = 0; i < GraphicsPSOInit.RenderTargetsEnabled; ++i)
3838 {
3839 if (PersistentState.CachedRenderTargets[i].Texture)
3840 {
3841 GraphicsPSOInit.RenderTargetFormats[i] = UE_PIXELFORMAT_TO_UINT8(PersistentState.CachedRenderTargets[i].Texture->GetFormat());
3842 GraphicsPSOInit.RenderTargetFlags[i] = PersistentState.CachedRenderTargets[i].Texture->GetFlags();
3843 }
3844 else
3845 {
3846 GraphicsPSOInit.RenderTargetFormats[i] = PF_Unknown;
3847 }
3848
3849 if (GraphicsPSOInit.RenderTargetFormats[i] != PF_Unknown)
3850 {
3851 GraphicsPSOInit.NumSamples = static_cast<uint16>(PersistentState.CachedRenderTargets[i].Texture->GetNumSamples());
3852 }
3853 }
3854
3855 if (PersistentState.CachedDepthStencilTarget.Texture)
3856 {
3857 GraphicsPSOInit.DepthStencilTargetFormat = PersistentState.CachedDepthStencilTarget.Texture->GetFormat();
3858 GraphicsPSOInit.DepthStencilTargetFlag = PersistentState.CachedDepthStencilTarget.Texture->GetFlags();
3859 const FRHITexture* TextureArray = PersistentState.CachedDepthStencilTarget.Texture->GetTexture2DArray();
3860 }
3861 else
3862 {
3863 GraphicsPSOInit.DepthStencilTargetFormat = PF_Unknown;
3864 }
3865
3866 GraphicsPSOInit.DepthTargetLoadAction = PersistentState.CachedDepthStencilTarget.DepthLoadAction;
3867 GraphicsPSOInit.DepthTargetStoreAction = PersistentState.CachedDepthStencilTarget.DepthStoreAction;
3868 GraphicsPSOInit.StencilTargetLoadAction = PersistentState.CachedDepthStencilTarget.StencilLoadAction;
3869 GraphicsPSOInit.StencilTargetStoreAction = PersistentState.CachedDepthStencilTarget.GetStencilStoreAction();
3870 GraphicsPSOInit.DepthStencilAccess = PersistentState.CachedDepthStencilTarget.GetDepthStencilAccess();
3871
3872 if (GraphicsPSOInit.DepthStencilTargetFormat != PF_Unknown)
3873 {
3874 GraphicsPSOInit.NumSamples = static_cast<uint16>(PersistentState.CachedDepthStencilTarget.Texture->GetNumSamples());
3875 }
3876
3877 GraphicsPSOInit.SubpassHint = PersistentState.SubpassHint;
3878 GraphicsPSOInit.SubpassIndex = PersistentState.SubpassIndex;
3879 GraphicsPSOInit.MultiViewCount = PersistentState.MultiViewCount;
3880 GraphicsPSOInit.bHasFragmentDensityAttachment = PersistentState.bHasFragmentDensityAttachment;
3881 }

4030 inline void BeginRenderPass(const FRHIRenderPassInfo& InInfo, const TCHAR* Name)
4031 {
4032 check(!IsInsideRenderPass());
4033 check(!IsInsideComputePass());
4034
4035 InInfo.Validate();
4036
4037 if (Bypass())
4038 {
4039 GetContext().RHIBeginRenderPass(InInfo, Name);
4040 }
4041 else
4042 {
4043 // Copy the transition array into the command list
4044 FRHIRenderPassInfo* InfoCopy = (FRHIRenderPassInfo*)Alloc(sizeof(FRHIRenderPassInfo), alignof(FRHIRenderPassInfo));
4045 FMemory::Memcpy(InfoCopy, &InInfo, sizeof(InInfo));
4046
4047 TCHAR* NameCopy = AllocString(Name);
4048 ALLOC_COMMAND(FRHICommandBeginRenderPass)(*InfoCopy, NameCopy);
4049 }
4050
4051 CacheActiveRenderTargets(InInfo);
4052 ResetSubpass(InInfo.SubpassHint);
4053 PersistentState.bInsideRenderPass = true;
4054
4055 if (InInfo.NumOcclusionQueries)
4056 {
4057 PersistentState.bInsideOcclusionQueryBatch = true;
4058 GDynamicRHI->RHIBeginRenderQueryBatch_TopOfPipe(*this, RQT_Occlusion);
4059 }
4060 }
4061
4062 void EndRenderPass()
4063 {
4064 check(IsInsideRenderPass());
4065 check(!IsInsideComputePass());
4066
4067 if (PersistentState.bInsideOcclusionQueryBatch)
4068 {
4069 GDynamicRHI->RHIEndRenderQueryBatch_TopOfPipe(*this, RQT_Occlusion);
4070 PersistentState.bInsideOcclusionQueryBatch = false;
4071 }
4072
4073 if (Bypass())
4074 {
4075 GetContext().RHIEndRenderPass();
4076 }
4077 else
4078 {
4079 ALLOC_COMMAND(FRHICommandEndRenderPass)();
4080 }
4081 PersistentState.bInsideRenderPass = false;
4082 ResetSubpass(ESubpassHint::None);
4083 }

4153 inline void SetBindingsOnShaderBindingTable(
4154 FRHIShaderBindingTable* SBT, FRayTracingPipelineState* Pipeline,
4155 uint32 NumBindings, const FRayTracingLocalShaderBindings* Bindings,
4156 ERayTracingBindingType BindingType,
4157 bool bCopyDataToInlineStorage = true)
4158 {
4159 if (Bypass())
4160 {
4161 GetContext().RHISetBindingsOnShaderBindingTable(SBT, GetRHIRayTracingPipelineState(Pipeline), NumBindings, Bindings, BindingType);
4162 }
4163 else
4164 {
4165 check(GetRHIRayTracingPipelineStateMaxLocalBindingDataSize(Pipeline) <= SBT->GetInitializer().LocalBindingDataSize);
4166
4167 FRayTracingLocalShaderBindings* InlineBindings = nullptr;
4168
4169 // By default all batch binding data is stored in the command list memory.
4170 // However, user may skip this copy if they take responsibility for keeping data alive until this command is executed.
4171 if (bCopyDataToInlineStorage)
4172 {
4173 if (NumBindings)
4174 {
4175 uint32 Size = sizeof(FRayTracingLocalShaderBindings) * NumBindings;
4176 InlineBindings = (FRayTracingLocalShaderBindings*)Alloc(Size, alignof(FRayTracingLocalShaderBindings));
4177 FMemory::Memcpy(InlineBindings, Bindings, Size);
4178 }
4179
4180 for (uint32 i = 0; i < NumBindings; ++i)
4181 {
4182 if (InlineBindings[i].NumUniformBuffers)
4183 {
4184 InlineBindings[i].UniformBuffers = (FRHIUniformBuffer**)Alloc(sizeof(FRHIUniformBuffer*) * InlineBindings[i].NumUniformBuffers, alignof(FRHIUniformBuffer*));
4185 for (uint32 Index = 0; Index < InlineBindings[i].NumUniformBuffers; ++Index)
4186 {
4187 InlineBindings[i].UniformBuffers[Index] = Bindings[i].UniformBuffers[Index];
4188 }
4189 }
4190
4191 if (InlineBindings[i].LooseParameterDataSize)
4192 {
4193 InlineBindings[i].LooseParameterData = (uint8*)Alloc(InlineBindings[i].LooseParameterDataSize, 16);
4194 FMemory::Memcpy(InlineBindings[i].LooseParameterData, Bindings[i].LooseParameterData, InlineBindings[i].LooseParameterDataSize);
4195 }
4196 }
4197
4198 ALLOC_COMMAND(FRHICommandSetBindingsOnShaderBindingTable)(SBT, Pipeline, NumBindings, InlineBindings, BindingType);
4199 }
4200 else
4201 {
4202 ALLOC_COMMAND(FRHICommandSetBindingsOnShaderBindingTable)(SBT, Pipeline, NumBindings, Bindings, BindingType);
4203 }
4204
4205 RHIThreadFence(true);
4206 }
4207 }

4353enum class ERHISubmitFlags
4354{
4355 None = 0,
4356
4357 // All submitted work will be processed, and the resulting platform command lists will be submitted to the GPU.
4358 SubmitToGPU = 1 << 0,
4359
4360 // Processes the delete queue until it is empty.
4361 DeleteResources = 1 << 1,
4362
4363 // Indicates that the entire RHI thread pipeline will be flushed.
4364 // If combined with DeleteResources, the pending deletes queue is processed in a loop until all released resources have been deleted.
4365 FlushRHIThread = 1 << 2,
4366
4367 // Marks the end of an engine frame. Causes RHI draw stats etc to be accumulated,
4368 // and calls RHIEndFrame for platform RHIs to do various cleanup tasks.
4369 EndFrame = 1 << 3,
4370
4371 // When combined with EndFrame, triggers a GPU profile on the following frame.
4372 ProfileNextFrame = 1 << 4,
4373
4374#if CAN_TOGGLE_COMMAND_LIST_BYPASS
4375 // Used when toggling RHI command bypass.
4376 EnableBypass = 1 << 5,
4377 DisableBypass = 1 << 6,
4378#endif
4379
4380#if WITH_RHI_BREADCRUMBS
4381 EnableDrawEvents = 1 << 7,
4382 DisableDrawEvents = 1 << 8
4383#endif
4384};

4473 template <typename LAMBDA>
4474 inline void EnqueueLambda(EThreadFence ThreadFence, const TCHAR* LambdaName, LAMBDA&& Lambda)
4475 {
4476 if (IsBottomOfPipe())
4477 {
4478 Lambda(*this);
4479 }
4480 else
4481 {
4482 ALLOC_COMMAND(TRHILambdaCommand<FRHICommandListImmediate, LAMBDA>)(Forward<LAMBDA>(Lambda), LambdaName);
4483
4484 if (ThreadFence == EThreadFence::Enabled)
4485 {
4486 RHIThreadFence(true);
4487 }
4488 }
4489 }
4490
4491 template <typename LAMBDA>
4492 inline void EnqueueLambda(const TCHAR* LambdaName, LAMBDA&& Lambda)
4493 {
4494 FRHICommandListImmediate::EnqueueLambda(EThreadFence::Disabled, TEXT("TRHILambdaCommand"), Forward<LAMBDA>(Lambda));
4495 }
4496
4497 template <typename LAMBDA>
4498 inline void EnqueueLambda(LAMBDA&& Lambda)
4499 {
4500 FRHICommandListImmediate::EnqueueLambda(TEXT("TRHILambdaCommand"), Forward<LAMBDA>(Lambda));
4501 }

4674 inline void SubmitAndBlockUntilGPUIdle(const bool bDeleteResources = false)
4675 {
4676 QUICK_SCOPE_CYCLE_COUNTER(STAT_RHIMETHOD_SubmitAndBlockUntilGPUIdle_Flush);
4677
4678 const EImmediateFlushType::Type FlushType = bDeleteResources ? EImmediateFlushType::FlushRHIThreadFlushResources : EImmediateFlushType::FlushRHIThread;
4679
4680 // Ensure all prior work is submitted down to the GPU, and the RHI thread is idle.
4681 ImmediateFlush(FlushType);
4682
4683 // Block the calling thread (the render thread) until the GPU completes all work.
4684 GDynamicRHI->RHIBlockUntilGPUIdle();
4685 }
4686

4849 }

4930// Helper class used internally by RHIs to make use of FRHICommandList_RecursiveHazardous safer.
4931// Access to the underlying context is exposed via RunOnContext() to ensure correct ordering of commands.
4932template <typename ContextType>
4933class TRHICommandList_RecursiveHazardous : public FRHICommandList_RecursiveHazardous
4934{
4935 template <typename LAMBDA>
4936 struct TRHILambdaCommand final : public FRHICommandBase
4937 {
4938 LAMBDA Lambda;
4939
4940 TRHILambdaCommand(LAMBDA&& InLambda)
4941 : Lambda(Forward<LAMBDA>(InLambda))
4942 {}
4943
4944 void ExecuteAndDestruct(FRHICommandListBase& CmdList) override final
4945 {
4946 // RunOnContext always requires the lowest level (platform) context, not the validation RHI context.
4947 ContextType& Context = static_cast<ContextType&>(CmdList.GetContext().GetLowestLevelContext());
4948 Context.BeginRecursiveCommand();
4949
4950 Lambda(Context);
4951 Lambda.~LAMBDA();
4952 }
4953 };
4954
4955public:
4956 TRHICommandList_RecursiveHazardous(ContextType* Context)
4957 : FRHICommandList_RecursiveHazardous(Context)
4958 {}
4959
4960 template <typename LAMBDA>
4961 inline void RunOnContext(LAMBDA&& Lambda)
4962 {
4963 if (Bypass())
4964 {
4965 // RunOnContext always requires the lowest level (platform) context, not the validation RHI context.
4966 ContextType& Context = static_cast<ContextType&>(GetContext().GetLowestLevelContext());
4967 Context.BeginRecursiveCommand();
4968
4969 Lambda(Context);
4970 }
4971 else
4972 {
4973 ALLOC_COMMAND(TRHILambdaCommand<LAMBDA>)(Forward<LAMBDA>(Lambda));
4974 }
4975 }
4976};

5048{
5049public:

5056
5057 //
5058 // Blocks the calling thread until all dispatch prerequisites of enqueued parallel command lists are completed.
5059 //
5060 void WaitForTasks()
5061 {
5062 WaitForTasks(WaitOutstandingTasks);
5063 }
5064
5065 //
5066 // Blocks the calling thread until all specified tasks are completed.
5067 //
5068 RHI_API void WaitForTasks(FGraphEventArray& OutstandingTasks);
5069
5070 // Global graph events must be destroyed explicitly to avoid undefined order of static destruction, as they can be destroyed after their allocator.
5071 void CleanupGraphEvents();
5072
5073 inline bool Bypass() const
5074 {
5075#if CAN_TOGGLE_COMMAND_LIST_BYPASS
5076 return bLatchedBypass;
5077#else
5078 return false;
5079#endif

5083 {
5084#if CAN_TOGGLE_COMMAND_LIST_BYPASS

5086#else

5088#endif

5091 //
5092 // Returns true if any RHI dispatch, translate or submission tasks are currently running.
5093 // This works regardless of engine threading mode (i.e. with or without an RHI thread and parallel translate).
5094 //
5095 // When this function returns false, we can be sure there are no threads active within the platform RHI, besides the render thread.
5096 //
5097 RHI_API static bool AreRHITasksActive();

5099 //
5100 // Adds a prerequisite for subsequent Submit dispatch tasks.
5101 //
5102 // This function should only be called from the render thread.
5103 //
5104 RHI_API void AddNextDispatchPrerequisite(FGraphEventRef Prereq);
5105
5106 //
5107 // Gets the CompletionEvent for the most recent submit to GPU
5108 //
5109 // This function should only be called from the render thread.
5110 //
5111 const FGraphEventRef& GetCompletionEvent() const
5112 {
5113 return CompletionEvent;
5114 }
5115
5116 FGraphEventArray WaitOutstandingTasks;

5118private:

5128
5129 //
5130 // Helper for efficiently enqueuing work to TaskGraph threads. Work items within a single pipe are always executed in-order (FIFO) even if they have no prerequisites.
5131 // Uses an atomic compare-and-swap mechanism to append new tasks to the end of existing ones, avoiding the overhead of having the TaskGraph itself do the task scheduling.
5132 //
5133 class FTaskPipe
5134 {
5135 struct FTask;
5136
5137 FTask* Current = nullptr;
5138 FGraphEventRef LastEvent = nullptr;
5139 TOptional<ENamedThreads::Type> LastThread {};
5140
5141 FGraphEventRef LaunchTask(FTask* Task) const;
5142 void Execute(FTask* Task, FGraphEventRef const& CurrentEvent) const;
5143
5144 public:
5145 struct ITask;
5146 using FFunc = TFunction<void(ITask&)>;
5147
5148 struct ITask
5149 {
5150 virtual void ExtendTask(FGraphEventArray&& NewPrereqs, FFunc&& NewLambda) = 0;
5151 };
5152
5153 // Enqueues the given lambda to run on the named thread.
5154 void Enqueue(ENamedThreads::Type NamedThread, FGraphEventArray&& Prereqs, FFunc&& Lambda);
5155
5156 // Returns a graph event that will be signalled once all work submitted prior to calling Close() has completed.
5157 FGraphEventRef Close();
5158
5159 void CleanupGraphEvents()
5160 {
5161 LastEvent = nullptr;
5162 }
5163 };
5164
5165 struct FSubmitState;
5166
5167 // One per RHI context array, multiple RHICmdLists replayed into it
5168 struct FTranslateState
5169 {
5170 struct FPipelineState
5171 {
5172#if WITH_RHI_BREADCRUMBS
5173 FRHIBreadcrumbRange Range {};
5174#endif
5175 IRHIComputeContext* Context = nullptr;
5176 };
5177 TRHIPipelineArray<FPipelineState> PipelineStates {};
5178
5179 IRHIUploadContext* UploadContext = nullptr;
5180
5181 FDynamicRHI::FRHICloseTranslateChainResult FinalizedCommandLists;
5182
5183#if WITH_RHI_BREADCRUMBS
5184 FRHIBreadcrumbAllocatorArray BreadcrumbAllocatorRefs {};
5185#endif
5186
5187 FTaskPipe TranslatePipe;
5188 uint32 NumCommands = 0;
5189
5190 FGraphEventRef TranslateEvent;
5191 std::atomic<FTranslateState*> Next { nullptr };
5192
5193 // True when parallel translate is enabled globally
5194 const bool bAllowParallelTranslate;
5195
5196 // True when this particular chain is a parallel translate chain
5197 const bool bParallel;
5198
5199 const bool bUsingSubCmdLists;
5200
5201 bool bShouldFinalize = true;
5202
5203 FTaskPipe* EnqueueTranslateTask(FGraphEventArray&& Prereqs, FTaskPipe::FFunc&& Lambda);
5204
5205 void Translate_ExecuteCommandList(FRHICommandListBase* CmdList);
5206 void Translate_CloseChain();
5207
5208 FTranslateState(const FSubmitState& SubmitState, FRHICommandListBase* FirstCmdList);
5209 };
5210
5211 // One per call to RHISubmitCommandLists
5212 struct FSubmitState
5213 {
5214 FGraphEventRef CompletionEvent;
5215
5216 struct
5217 {
5218 TArray<TUniquePtr<FTranslateState>> All;
5219 FGraphEventArray Events;
5220
5221 FTranslateState* First = nullptr;
5222 FTranslateState* Current = nullptr;
5223 FTranslateState* Previous = nullptr;
5224 } TranslateJobs;
5225
5226 int32 MaxCommandsPerTranslate = 0;
5227 bool bAllowSingleParallelCombine = false;
5228 bool bAllowParallelTranslate = true;
5229 bool bBatchSubmissions = true;
5230
5231 #if WITH_RHI_BREADCRUMBS
5232 bool bEmitBreadcrumbs = false;
5233 #endif
5234
5235 ERHISubmitFlags SubmitFlags = ERHISubmitFlags::None;
5236 TArray<FRHIResource*> ResourcesToDelete {};
5237 bool bIncludeExtendedLifetimeResources = false;
5238
5239 FGraphEventRef BeginGraphEvent;
5240 FGraphEventArray ChildGraphEvents;
5241
5242 struct FCloseArgs
5243 {
5244#if WITH_RHI_BREADCRUMBS
5245 TRHIPipelineArray<FRHIBreadcrumbNode*> GPUBreadcrumbs;
5246#endif
5247#if STATS
5248 TOptional<int64> StatsFrame;
5249#endif
5250 };
5251
5252 void Dispatch_ProcessCommandList(FRHICommandListBase* CmdList);
5253 void Dispatch_PrepareBreadcrumbs(FRHICommandListBase* CmdList);
5254 FGraphEventRef Dispatch_CloseTranslateChain(bool bLastChainInSubmission, uint32 RTSubmissionID);
5255 void Dispatch_CloseSubmission(TOptional<int64> LocalStatsFrame, uint32 RTSubmissionID);
5256
5257 void Submit_SubmitToGPU(FTranslateState* First, FTaskPipe::ITask& Task, uint64 TracingSubmissionID);
5258 void Submit_Close(const FCloseArgs& Args);
5259 } *SubmitState = nullptr;
5260
5261 FTaskPipe DispatchPipe;
5262 FTaskPipe SingleTranslatePipe;
5263 FTaskPipe SubmitPipe;
5264
5265 FGraphEventRef LastMutate;
5266 FGraphEventRef LastClose;
5267 FGraphEventRef CompletionEvent;
5268
5269 void EnqueueDispatchTask(FGraphEventArray&& Prereqs, FTaskPipe::FFunc&& Lambda);
5270 void EnqueueSubmitTask (FGraphEventArray&& Prereqs, FTaskPipe::FFunc&& Lambda);
5271 FGraphEventArray NextDispatchTaskPrerequisites;
5272
5273#if WITH_RHI_BREADCRUMBS
5274
5275 struct FBreadcrumbState
5276 {
5277 FRHIBreadcrumbNodeRef Current{}; // Used by dispatch thread
5278 FRHIBreadcrumbNodeRef Last {}; // Used by submit thread
5279 };
5280
5281 struct
5282 {
5283 FBreadcrumbState CPU {};
5284 TRHIPipelineArray<FBreadcrumbState> GPU { InPlace };
5285 } Breadcrumbs {};
5286
5287#endif
5288
5289 // Counts the number of calls to RHIEndFrame, and is used in GPU profiler frame boundary events.
5290 uint32 FrameNumber = 0;
5291
5292 bool AllowParallel() const;
5293};

5552 //
5553 // Copies shared mip levels from one texture to another.
5554 // Both textures must have full mip chains, share the same format, and have the same aspect ratio.
5555 // The source texture must be in the CopySrc state, and the destination texture must be in the CopyDest state.
5556 //
5557 RHI_API void CopySharedMips(FRHICommandList& RHICmdList, FRHITexture* SrcTexture, FRHITexture* DstTexture);
5558
5559 //
5560 // Same as CopySharedMips(), but assumes both source and destination textures are in the SRVMask state.
5561 // Adds transitions to move the textures to/from the CopySrc/CopyDest states, restoring SRVMask when done.
5562 //
5563 // Provided for backwards compatibility. Caller should prefer CopySharedMips() with optimally batched transitions.
5564 //
5565 RHI_API void CopySharedMips_AssumeSRVMaskState(FRHICommandList& RHICmdList, FRHITexture* SrcTexture, FRHITexture* DstTexture);
5566
5567 // Backwards compatibility adaptor to convert new FRHIBatchedShaderParameters to legacy FRayTracingShaderBindings.
5568 // This function will be deprecated in a future release, once legacy FRayTracingShaderBindings is removed.
5569 RHI_API FRayTracingShaderBindings ConvertRayTracingShaderBindings(const FRHIBatchedShaderParameters& BatchedParameters);
5570
5571}
